newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan key 3-mth CD rate falls to two-month low. [CORRECTED 04:07 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Japan key 3-mth CD rate falls to two-month low. [CORRECTED 04:07 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects the time frame in the headline to two months from three months.)

The rate on Japan's key three-month certificates of deposit (CD) on Wednesday fell to 0.55 percent, the lowest since June 19, after the Bank of Japan's key 'tankan' corporate survey turned out to be weaker than expected, traders said.
About 70 billion yen worth of three-month CDs were issued at 0.55 percent.
